events.description: Three years. Two sold-out events. One mission. Alpha Events is the Gold Coast-based promotion behind Podcast Royale — the only event in Australia where podcasters, creators, and personalities trade microphones for boxing gloves and step into the ring in front of thousands. What started as a wild idea has become a flagship night in the Australian events calendar. Sold-out crowds. Standing-room only. And every year, it gets bigger. Podcast Royale 3.0 is the third edition. Same chaos. More fights. Bigger venue. Louder crowd. This is what we do — once a year, we put on the show no one else will.
